module_summary: Direct-mapped write-through cache controller: a 5-state FSM latches CPU requests, checks tag/valid arrays for hit, refills or writes through to memory via req/ack, and responds.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: IDLE/LOOKUP/WRITE_MEM/REFILL/RESPOND controller; decodes ready, stall, resp_valid, mem_req, mem_we.

anchors.name: tag_array
anchors.why: Per-line tag storage written on refill, compared for hit.

anchors.name: data_array
anchors.why: Per-line data storage filled from mem_rdata or updated by write hits.

anchors.name: cpu_req_valid
anchors.why: CPU request valid; starts lookup and latches address/data/we.

anchors.name: cpu_req_ready
anchors.why: Ready to accept CPU request when FSM is IDLE.

anchors.name: cpu_resp_valid
anchors.why: One-cycle response pulse in RESPOND accompanying cpu_rdata.

anchors.name: mem_req
anchors.why: Memory request asserted during REFILL and WRITE_MEM.

anchors.name: mem_ack
anchors.why: Memory acknowledge completing refill/write; advances FSM and writes arrays.

anchors.name: hit
anchors.why: Valid bit and tag match; chooses RESPOND vs REFILL, gates write-hit update.

anchors.name: addr_q
anchors.why: Latched request address supplying index, tag, and mem_addr.

anchors.name: cpu_rdata
anchors.why: CPU read data from rdata_q, loaded from hit, refill, or write data.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Refill data from memory into data_array and rdata_q.

anchors.name: wdata_q
anchors.why: Latched write data driving mem_wdata and write-hit update.

anchors.name: we_q
anchors.why: Latched write command steering LOOKUP to WRITE_MEM.

anchors.name: valid_bits
anchors.why: Per-line valid flags set on refill, used in hit.

anchors.name: index
anchors.why: Line index from addr_q addressing tag, data, valid arrays.

anchors.name: cpu_addr
anchors.why: CPU request address latched into addr_q.

anchors.name: cpu_we
anchors.why: Read/write command latched into we_q.

anchors.name: cpu_wdata
anchors.why: CPU write data latched into wdata_q.

anchors.name: mem_we
anchors.why: Memory write command decoded from WRITE_MEM state.

anchors.name: stall_o
anchors.why: Busy indication while FSM is neither IDLE nor RESPOND.

groups.name: cache_fsm
groups.description: Five-state controller sequencing lookup, write-through, refill, and response.

groups.name: cache_arrays
groups.description: Direct-mapped tag, data, and valid arrays indexed by addr_q.

groups.name: request_latch
groups.description: Latched CPU request fields and response data register.

groups.name: mem_port
groups.description: Memory req/ack interface for refill and write-through.
